heading: 14.4 Schema field type
text:
### 14.4 Schema field type [LUNI.14.4]

`complex <unit>` — two-token field type. `complex` keyword followed by an optional
unit symbol; omitting the unit leaves both components plain `Float64`. Both real
and imaginary components carry the declared unit. Values are
stored in base units of the declared dimension, same as scalar unit fields.
